===Levels 82–99: Anglerfish===
{{Main|Raw anglerfish}}
At level 82 Fishing, you can start catching [[anglerfish]] in Port Piscarilius. In order to catch anglerfish, [[sandworms]] and a [[fishing rod]] are required. Sandworms can be purchased from [[Tynan's Fishing Supplies]] nearby or the [[Grand Exchange]].

Players can gain around 15,000 experience per hour at level 82, and 23,000 experience per hour at level 90. If [[diabolic worms]] are used this improves to around 30,000 experience per hour at level 82, and 39,000 experience per hour at level 99.

* Starting experience - 2,421,087
* Experience needed - 10,613,344
* Anglerfish needed - 88,445
* Profit made (82-99): {{Coins|{{GEPT|Raw anglerfish|88445}}}} 
* If cooked: {{Coins|{{GEPT|anglerfish|88445}}}}
